canonical_statement: Corollary 5.9 of Gubinelli--Imkeller--Perkowski: local existence and uniqueness for the generalized parabolic Anderson model with spatial white noise on T^2, characterized by convergence in probability of renormalized mollified solutions up to an almost-surely positive data-measurable stopping time.

hypotheses: xi_epsilon is the spatial mollification of xi

conclusion: A unique local solution u exists; for a measurable random time tau positive almost surely, the renormalized classical solutions u_epsilon converge to u in probability in the stopped C^alpha norm.
